instruction: The Stage-1, Stage-2, and Phase-E records are immutable. Inspect the paired case only now. Classify provenance for every Phase-E missing client fact, distinguish sibling necessity from corroboration, apply the fixed verdict precedence, and record narrow bilingual/clinical/scope collateral observations. Do not revise Phase E and do not propose content edits beyond an advisory P0-P3 priority.

content.en:
Background: Margaret has a 3-year history of Alzheimer's dementia and is followed by a memory-care clinic. Medical history includes hypertension treated with amlodipine 5 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily, osteoarthritis of both knees, and remote left hip fracture repair 5 years ago. She has not been seen by the memory-care clinic in 9 months because Diane could not get time off work.

Initial presentation at 10:00 AM Tuesday: Diane appears fatigued with dark circles, took a half-day off work, and must leave by noon. A neighbor will stay with Margaret from noon until Diane returns from work, but this is an informal favor. Diane reports Margaret was up 4 times last night and tried to go outside at 2 AM. Diane has been placing a chair against Margaret's bedroom door at night because she cannot stay awake. Diane has slept less than 4 consecutive hours for weeks, lost 12 lb in 2 months, called in sick to work 3 times last month, and says she promised her father she would never place Margaret in a home.

Margaret is seated in a recliner wearing a urine-stained housecoat with a faint urine odor. A half-eaten bowl of oatmeal is on the side table. Diane reports Margaret has refused more meals and lost about 8 lb over 3 months. Pill bottles are on the kitchen counter with tops off two bottles. A Wednesday-slot pill organizer is open, but today is Tuesday.
content.zh:
背景：Margaret 有3年阿尔茨海默病史，由记忆门诊随访。病史包括高血压（每日氨氯地平5 mg、赖诺普利10 mg）、双膝骨关节炎，以及5年前左髋骨折修复。因 Diane 无法请假，Margaret 已9个月未到记忆门诊复诊。

周二上午10:00初次表现：Diane 看起来疲惫、有黑眼圈，请了半天假，必须在中午前离开。中午后邻居会陪 Margaret 到 Diane 下班回来，但这只是非正式帮忙。Diane 报告 Margaret 昨晚醒来4次，凌晨2点试图外出。因为自己无法保持清醒，Diane 夜间把椅子抵在 Margaret 卧室门口。Diane 数周来连续睡眠不足4小时，2个月内减重12磅，上个月请病假3次，并说曾答应父亲绝不把 Margaret 送进机构。

Margaret 坐在躺椅上，穿着有尿渍且有淡淡尿味的家居服。边桌上有半碗燕麦。Diane 报告 Margaret 更常拒食，3个月内约减重8磅。厨房台面上有药瓶，其中两个瓶盖打开。星期三药格处于打开状态，但今天是星期二。

title.zh: 初次居家护理访视记录

content.en:
Margaret: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 76 regular, BP 148/88, RR 16, SpO₂ 97% room air. Weight 58 kg; weight 9 months ago was 61.6 kg. Alert, oriented only to first name; does not know date, season, or address. Follows one-step commands but not two-step commands. Speech fluent with word-finding pauses and occasional confabulation. Calls the nurse by her late husband's name twice. Skin intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas. Bilateral knee crepitus with mild swelling. Gait slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean; ambulates short distances independently. Grip strength symmetric and adequate. Oral mucosa slightly dry. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Perineal skin intact but mildly erythematous from urine contact. Diane reports urinary incontinence 2-3 times daily, pull-up briefs during the day, and no fecal incontinence.

Diane: Hands tremble slightly when opening pill bottles. Reports headaches almost daily, difficulty concentrating at work, and feeling angry then guilty when Margaret repeats questions. Denies thoughts of harming herself or Margaret. Has not seen her own primary care provider in over a year. Has not attended a caregiver support group and does not know what respite care is.

Home: Single-story ranch. Bathroom grab bars and hallway night-lights are present. Front door has a standard deadbolt Margaret can unlock. Stove knobs are not covered or disabled. Throw rugs are in the kitchen and hallway. Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink. A wooden chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob.

Labs from primary care office 1 week ago: sodium 141 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, fasting glucose 102 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL, prealbumin 14 mg/dL, TSH 2.8 mIU/L, hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, hematocrit 35%, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Urinalysis: trace leukocytes, no nitrites, specific gravity 1.028.
content.zh:
Margaret：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 76次/分且规则，BP 148/88，RR 16次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 97%。体重58 kg；9个月前体重61.6 kg。清醒，仅能说出自己的名字；不知道日期、季节或地址。能执行一步指令，不能执行两步指令。言语流利但有找词困难和偶发虚构。两次把护士称为已故丈夫的名字。皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。双膝骨擦感伴轻度肿胀。步态缓慢、基底较宽、轻度前倾；可在家中短距离独立行走。握力对称且足够。口腔黏膜轻度干燥。腹部柔软、无压痛。会阴皮肤完整但因尿液接触轻度发红。Diane 报告每天尿失禁2–3次，白天穿拉拉裤，无大便失禁。

Diane：打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。报告几乎每天头痛，工作时难以集中注意力，当 Margaret 重复提问时会先愤怒后内疚。否认有伤害自己或 Margaret 的想法。已超过1年未看自己的初级保健医生。未参加过照护者支持小组，也不知道喘息服务是什么。

家庭环境：单层牧场式住宅。浴室有扶手，走廊有夜灯。前门是普通插销锁，Margaret 能打开。炉灶旋钮未加盖也未停用。厨房和走廊有小地毯。清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。卧室门把手下抵着一把木椅。

1周前初级保健诊所化验：钠141 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，空腹血糖102 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白14 mg/dL，TSH 2.8 mIU/L，血红蛋白11.8 g/dL，红细胞压积35%，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板210 ×10³/µL。尿检：白细胞微量，亚硝酸盐阴性，比重1.028。

glossary.defZh: 照护需求超过可用支持或能力时，照护者难以承担角色。
从受看护环境中不安全地离开或走失。
一组相互关联、共同指向优先问题的评估发现。

segments.en: Margaret is oriented only to her first name.
segments.zh: Margaret 仅能说出自己的名字，无法定向到日期、季节或地址。

segments.en: Her housecoat is urine-stained and has a faint urine odor.
segments.zh: 她的家居服有尿渍并有淡淡尿味。

segments.en: Perineal skin is mildly erythematous from urine contact.
segments.zh: 会阴皮肤因尿液接触轻度发红。

segments.en: Weight has decreased from 61.6 kg nine months ago to 58 kg today.
segments.zh: 体重从9个月前的61.6 kg下降到今天的58 kg。

segments.en: Albumin is 3.1 g/dL and prealbumin is 14 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白为3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白为14 mg/dL。

segments.en: Oral mucosa is slightly dry.
segments.zh: 口腔黏膜轻度干燥。

segments.en: Blood pressure is 148/88 while medication administration is unreliable.
segments.zh: 在用药不可靠的情况下，BP为148/88。

segments.en: Gait is slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean.
segments.zh: 步态缓慢、基底较宽，并轻度前倾。

segments.en: Skin is intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas.
segments.zh: 皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。

segments.en: Grip strength is symmetric and adequate.
segments.zh: 握力对称且足够。

segments.en: Temperature is 98.2 °F (36.8 °C) and SpO₂ is 97% on room air.
segments.zh: 体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，室内空气下SpO₂为97%。

segments.en: Diane reports sleeping less than four consecutive hours for weeks.
segments.zh: Diane 报告数周来连续睡眠不足4小时。

segments.en: Diane has lost twelve pounds in two months because she forgets to eat.
segments.zh: Diane 因忘记吃饭，两个月内减重12磅。

segments.en: Diane's hands tremble when she opens the pill bottles.
segments.zh: Diane 打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。

segments.en: Diane called in sick to work three times last month.
segments.zh: Diane 上个月请病假3次。

segments.en: Diane becomes tearful and says she promised not to place Margaret in a home.
segments.zh: Diane 哭泣，并说她承诺过不把 Margaret 送进机构。

segments.en: A chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob at night.
segments.zh: 夜间有一把椅子抵在卧室门把手下。

segments.en: Pill bottles are open and the wrong-day pill organizer is in use.
segments.zh: 药瓶敞开，且药盒日期使用混乱。

segments.en: The front door has a deadbolt Margaret can unlock.
segments.zh: 前门是 Margaret 能打开的普通插销锁。

segments.en: Stove knobs are uncovered and enabled.
segments.zh: 炉灶旋钮未加盖，也未停用。

segments.en: Throw rugs are present in the kitchen and hallway.
segments.zh: 厨房和走廊有小地毯。

segments.en: Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink.
segments.zh: 清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。

segments.en: Grab bars and night-lights are already present.
segments.zh: 浴室扶手和夜灯已经安装。

byChoice.en: Severe disorientation increases wandering, medication, and home-safety risk.
byChoice.zh: 严重定向障碍会增加走失、用药错误和居家安全风险。

byChoice.en: Urine-stained clothing suggests unmet toileting or hygiene needs and risk for skin breakdown.
byChoice.zh: 衣物有尿渍提示如厕或清洁需求未被充分满足，并有皮肤受损风险。

byChoice.en: Erythema from urine contact requires incontinence and skin-protection interventions.
byChoice.zh: 尿液接触导致的发红需要进行失禁管理和皮肤保护。

byChoice.en: A 3.6 kg loss in an older adult with dementia signals nutritional decline.
byChoice.zh: 老年痴呆患者体重下降3.6 kg提示营养状态下降。

byChoice.en: Low nutrition markers reinforce concern for inadequate intake and nutritional risk.
byChoice.zh: 营养相关指标偏低进一步支持摄入不足和营养风险。

byChoice.en: Dry mucosa and concentrated urine suggest possible inadequate fluid intake.
byChoice.zh: 口腔黏膜干燥和尿液浓缩提示可能液体摄入不足。

byChoice.en: Elevated BP matters because the antihypertensive routine is not reliable.
byChoice.zh: 血压升高需要关注，因为降压药给药流程并不可靠。

byChoice.en: This gait pattern, osteoarthritis, prior hip fracture, and home hazards increase fall risk.
byChoice.zh: 这种步态结合骨关节炎、既往髋部骨折和居家危险物会增加跌倒风险。

byChoice.en: This lowers concern for acute inflicted injury but does not make the home situation safe.
byChoice.zh: 这降低了急性人为外伤的担忧，但不能说明居家环境已经安全。

byChoice.en: Symmetric grip strength is not a priority cue in this caregiver-safety problem.
byChoice.zh: 握力对称不是本题照护者与居家安全问题中的优先线索。

byChoice.en: Normal temperature and oxygenation do not explain the caregiver strain or home hazards.
byChoice.zh: 体温和氧合正常不能解释照护者压力或居家危险。

byChoice.en: Sleep deprivation is a major caregiver role strain cue and threatens safe supervision.
byChoice.zh: 睡眠剥夺是照护者角色压力的重要线索，并威胁安全看护。

byChoice.en: Caregiver weight loss shows her own health is deteriorating.
byChoice.zh: 照护者体重下降说明她自身健康正在恶化。

byChoice.en: Trembling during medication tasks suggests overload and risk for administration errors.
byChoice.zh: 处理药物时手颤提示负荷过重，并增加给药错误风险。

byChoice.en: Work impairment is functional evidence that caregiving demands are overwhelming her.
byChoice.zh: 工作受影响是照护需求已使她不堪重负的功能性证据。

byChoice.en: Tearfulness and guilt reveal grief and caregiver role strain that must be addressed.
byChoice.zh: 哭泣和内疚反映悲伤和照护者角色压力，必须处理。

byChoice.en: The barricade is an unsafe restraint-like strategy used to manage wandering.
byChoice.zh: 用椅子挡门是为处理走失而采取的不安全、类似限制的做法。

byChoice.en: Medication disorganization is a direct safety cue.
byChoice.zh: 用药混乱是直接的安全线索。

byChoice.en: An exterior door the client can unlock creates elopement risk.
byChoice.zh: 患者能打开的外门会造成走失风险。

byChoice.en: Unsecured stove access is an immediate fire and burn hazard.
byChoice.zh: 炉灶未防护是即时火灾和烧伤风险。

byChoice.en: Throw rugs are modifiable trip hazards in a client with gait risk.
byChoice.zh: 小地毯是可改变的绊倒危险，尤其对有步态风险的患者。

byChoice.en: Unlocked chemicals are unsafe for a client with moderate dementia.
byChoice.zh: 对中度痴呆患者来说，未上锁化学清洁品不安全。

byChoice.en: These are protective features, not significant new safety cues requiring follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 这些是保护性设施，不是需要跟进的重要新危险线索。

correct.en: The significant cue cluster includes Margaret's cognitive impairment, nutritional decline, possible dehydration, incontinence-related skin risk, elevated BP with unreliable medication administration, gait/fall risk, and multiple environmental hazards. Diane's sleep deprivation, weight loss, tremor, missed work, guilt, unsafe door barricade, and medication disorganization show caregiver role strain that directly affects Margaret's safety. Normal temperature, oxygenation, symmetric grip, intact skin, grab bars, and night-lights do not remove the need for follow-up.
correct.zh: 重要线索包括 Margaret 的认知受损、营养下降、可能脱水、失禁相关皮肤风险、在用药不可靠情况下的血压升高、步态/跌倒风险以及多项环境危险。Diane 的睡眠剥夺、体重下降、手颤、误工、内疚、不安全挡门和药物混乱显示照护者角色压力，并直接影响 Margaret 的安全。体温、氧合、握力、皮肤完整、扶手和夜灯等正常或保护性发现不能消除跟进需要。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 home-visit data, highlight the findings that are significant cues requiring nursing attention.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段居家访视资料，标出需要护理关注的重要线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: In home-care dementia questions, assess two clients: the person with dementia and the caregiver. Normal physical findings can reduce concern for one problem but do not cancel environmental or caregiver-capacity risks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在痴呆居家护理题中，要同时评估两个人：痴呆患者和照护者。正常体征可能降低某一问题的担忧，但不能抵消环境风险或照护能力风险。

glossary.defZh: 根据当地法律和政策，调查并处理易受伤害成人疑似虐待、忽视或剥削的公共系统。
未能满足基本安全或照护需求，可为故意或非故意。
以信任为基础的护患关系，可支持评估、教育和行为改变。

options.en: The home situation is unsalvageable because Diane missed a clinic appointment, so the nurse should recommend immediate removal from the home as the first response.
options.zh: 由于 Diane 错过了门诊复诊，居家照护已无法挽回，因此护士的第一反应应是建议立即离家安置。

options.en: The problem is only medication nonadherence; the nurse should focus on the pill organizer and avoid discussing caregiver stress or home hazards.
options.zh: 问题只是服药不依从；护士应只关注药盒，避免讨论照护者压力或居家危险。

options.en: Because Margaret has no bruises or lacerations, the nurse should reassure Diane that no safety documentation or follow-up is needed.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 没有瘀斑或裂伤，护士应安慰 Diane 不需要安全记录或跟进。

options.en: The chair barricade and raised voice prove intentional physical abuse, so the nurse should accuse Diane and demand immediate facility placement before completing the assessment.
options.zh: 椅子挡门和提高音量证明存在故意身体虐待，因此护士应指责 Diane，并在完成评估前要求立即机构安置。

options.en: The pattern best supports caregiver role strain with unsafe compensatory strategies; respond nonjudgmentally, correct immediate hazards, document, notify the provider/supervisor or social work, and follow agency/state APS policy if neglect is suspected or safety cannot be maintained.
options.zh: 该模式最支持照护者角色压力并伴有不安全的补偿性做法；应以非评判方式回应，纠正即时危险，记录，通知医师/主管或社工，并在怀疑忽视或无法维持安全时按机构/州政策联系成人保护服务。

byChoice.en: This response matches the total pattern and preserves the therapeutic relationship while still addressing safety and reporting obligations.
byChoice.zh: 该回应符合整体模式，在处理安全和报告责任的同时保持治疗性关系。

byChoice.en: Immediate removal is not the first response when Diane denies intent to harm, is receptive to help, and the hazards are modifiable with urgent support and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 当 Diane 否认伤害意图、愿意接受帮助，且危险可通过紧急支持和监测来改善时，立即离家安置不是第一反应。

byChoice.en: Medication errors matter, but they are only one part of a larger pattern involving caregiver exhaustion, elopement, stove safety, nutrition, and incontinence.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误很重要，但只是更大问题的一部分，包括照护者疲惫、走失、炉灶安全、营养和失禁。

byChoice.en: Absence of bruising lowers concern for inflicted injury but does not make the home safe or remove documentation and follow-up duties.
byChoice.zh: 没有瘀斑可降低人为外伤的担忧，但不能说明居家环境安全，也不能免除记录和跟进责任。

byChoice.en: The barricade and raised voice are serious cues, but they do not by themselves prove intentional physical abuse; accusing Diane prematurely can damage trust and does not replace safety planning.
byChoice.zh: 挡门和提高音量是严重线索，但不能单独证明故意身体虐待；过早指责 Diane 会破坏信任，也不能替代安全计划。

correct.en: Diane's behavior is unsafe but the overall pattern is most consistent with caregiver role strain: she is exhausted, guilty, tearful, receptive to help, and voluntarily requested support. The nurse should not ignore the hazards or excuse unsafe care; the correct response is nonjudgmental support plus documentation, team notification, safety planning, and policy-guided APS reporting assessment if safety cannot be maintained or neglect is suspected.
correct.zh: Diane 的做法不安全，但整体模式最符合照护者角色压力：她疲惫、内疚、哭泣、愿意接受帮助，并主动请求支持。护士不能忽视危险或纵容不安全照护；正确回应是非评判支持，同时记录、通知团队、制定安全计划，并在无法维持安全或怀疑忽视时按政策评估是否需报告成人保护服务。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which interpretation of the findings and nursing response is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段，哪一种对评估发现的解释和护理回应最合适？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not classify elder-safety cases from one cue alone. Compare intent, injury pattern, caregiver affect, willingness to accept help, and whether hazards can be modified.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要仅凭单一线索判断老年人安全问题。要比较意图、损伤模式、照护者情绪、接受帮助的意愿，以及危险是否可改变。

glossary.defZh: 如果现在不处理，最可能导致严重伤害的风险。
如门警报等安全设备，可提醒照护者而不限制患者行动。
具有抗胆碱作用的药物累积造成的认知和身体影响。

options.en: Defer environmental changes until the follow-up visit because Margaret is currently calm.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 目前平静，所以将环境改变推迟到复诊时再处理。

options.en: Focus first on rechecking the blood pressure and teaching Diane to restart the Wednesday pill compartment tomorrow.
options.zh: 首先重新测量血压，并教 Diane 明天重新使用星期三药格。

options.en: Before Diane leaves today, ensure Margaret is not left in an unsafe environment: remove the bedroom-door barricade, use a nonrestrictive door-alert strategy, prevent unsupervised stove access, orient the neighbor to safety monitoring and emergency contacts, and notify the provider about diphenhydramine use.
options.zh: 在 Diane 今天离开前，确保 Margaret 不会被留在不安全环境中：移除卧室挡门，采用非限制性的门警报策略，防止无人看护时接触炉灶，向邻居说明安全看护和紧急联系方式，并通知医师有关苯海拉明使用情况。

options.en: Schedule a caregiver support group before addressing the stove, door, or neighbor supervision plan.
options.zh: 先安排照护者支持小组，再处理炉灶、门或邻居看护计划。

options.en: Prioritize a dietary consult and weekly weights because the albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先安排营养会诊和每周称重，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

byChoice.en: Blood pressure and pill-organizer correction are important, but they do not control the immediate environmental threats.
byChoice.zh: 血压和药盒纠正很重要，但不能控制即时环境危险。

byChoice.en: Current calmness does not remove the risk; Margaret already turned on a burner and attempted nighttime elopement.
byChoice.zh: 目前平静并不消除风险；Margaret 已经打开过炉灶，也曾夜间试图离家。

byChoice.en: Support groups help sustainability but do not protect Margaret during today's period of supervision by the neighbor.
byChoice.zh: 支持小组有助于长期维持，但不能保护 Margaret 今天由邻居看护期间的安全。

byChoice.en: This option addresses the immediate elopement, fire/burn, temporary supervision, and medication-related confusion risks before Diane leaves.
byChoice.zh: 该选项在 Diane 离开前处理走失、火灾/烧伤、临时看护和药物相关混乱等即时风险。

byChoice.en: Nutritional decline needs follow-up, but it is less immediate than a client turning on burners or leaving the house unsafely.
byChoice.zh: 营养下降需要跟进，但不如患者打开炉灶或不安全离家那样紧迫。

correct.en: The immediate threat is that Margaret may be left with uncontrolled elopement and stove hazards while Diane returns to work. The nurse must replace the unsafe barricade with a nonrestrictive alert strategy, control stove access, orient the temporary caregiver, and contact the provider about diphenhydramine because it worsens confusion and compounds fall and wandering risk. Nutrition, BP, and caregiver support are important but not the most immediate life-safety threats before Diane leaves.
correct.zh: 即时威胁是 Diane 回去上班后，Margaret 可能面临未控制的走失和炉灶危险。护士必须用非限制性警报策略替代不安全挡门，控制炉灶接触，指导临时照护者，并就苯海拉明联系医师，因为它会加重意识混乱并增加跌倒和走失风险。营养、血压和照护者支持都重要，但不是 Diane 离开前最紧迫的生命安全威胁。

stem.en: After the Stage 2 disclosures, which priority should the nurse address before leaving the home today?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段补充信息后，护士今天离开该家庭前应优先处理什么？

testTakingStrategy.en: When several problems are real, choose the action that prevents the most immediate serious harm before the next handoff or period of reduced supervision.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题都真实存在时，选择能在下一次交接或看护减少前防止最即时严重伤害的行动。

glossary.defZh: 通过正式或非正式照护支持，为主要照护者提供暂时休息。
在失禁发生前按计划提醒并协助如厕。
在白天提供看护、活动和支持的社区项目。

options.en: Contact the provider and pharmacist about medication formulations and diphenhydramine use; set up alarms, a written schedule, and a clarified pill-organizer routine.
options.zh: 就药物剂型和苯海拉明使用联系医师及药师；设置提醒、书面时间表，并明确药盒流程。

options.en: Remove the bedroom-door barricade and use door alarms or contact sensors on exterior doors; consider medical identification and a local wandering-response program.
options.zh: 移除卧室挡门，在外门使用门警报或门磁感应器；考虑医疗识别饰品和当地走失应对项目。

options.en: Continue diphenhydramine at a lower dose and keep the chair barricade until Margaret stops wandering.
options.zh: 继续较低剂量苯海拉明，并保留椅子挡门，直到 Margaret 停止走失。

options.en: Remove throw rugs, lock cleaning supplies, maintain lighting, and coordinate physical therapy for gait and fall-risk assessment.
options.zh: 移除小地毯，锁好清洁用品，保持照明，并协调物理治疗评估步态和跌倒风险。

options.en: Prevent unsupervised stove use by using knob covers, removing knobs, or disconnecting the stove when not supervised.
options.zh: 通过旋钮保护盖、取下旋钮，或在无人看护时断开炉灶，防止无人看护使用炉灶。

options.en: Address nutrition, incontinence, and caregiver support with dietitian referral, preferred small frequent meals, prompted toileting, moisture barrier, social work, Area Agency on Aging, adult day program, caregiver support group, and Diane's own primary-care visit.
options.zh: 通过营养师转介、少量多餐且选择偏好食物、定时提醒如厕、皮肤屏障霜、社工、老龄事务机构、成人日间照护、照护者支持小组以及 Diane 自己的初级保健就诊，处理营养、失禁和照护者支持。

byChoice.en: Diphenhydramine can worsen confusion and falls in older adults with dementia, and a chair barricade is an unsafe restriction rather than a safe wandering strategy.
byChoice.zh: 苯海拉明可加重老年痴呆患者的混乱和跌倒风险，而椅子挡门是不安全限制，不是安全的走失管理策略。

byChoice.en: Medication errors and OTC diphenhydramine use require provider/pharmacist involvement and a simpler routine.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误和非处方苯海拉明使用需要医师/药师介入，并建立更简单的流程。

byChoice.en: Stove control is necessary because Margaret has already turned on a burner without safe supervision.
byChoice.zh: 必须控制炉灶，因为 Margaret 已经在缺乏安全看护时打开过炉灶。

byChoice.en: Door alarms reduce elopement risk without confining Margaret behind a barricade.
byChoice.zh: 门警报可降低走失风险，同时避免用挡门限制 Margaret。

byChoice.en: Nutrition, skin protection, incontinence management, respite, and caregiver health are all required for a sustainable home plan.
byChoice.zh: 营养、皮肤保护、失禁管理、喘息服务和照护者健康都是可持续居家计划所必需的。

byChoice.en: Fall and poisoning hazards are modifiable environmental risks in this home.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒和中毒危险是该家庭中可改变的环境风险。

correct.en: The plan must address both sides of the dyad: Margaret's safety risks and Diane's ability to continue caregiving. Appropriate interventions include nonrestrictive wandering alerts, stove control, fall and hazardous-material prevention, medication-formulation and reminder support, provider notification about diphenhydramine, nutrition and incontinence support, respite/adult day resources, social work, caregiver support, and Diane's own health care.
correct.zh: 计划必须同时处理照护关系中的两方面：Margaret 的安全风险和 Diane 持续照护的能力。合适干预包括非限制性走失警报、炉灶控制、跌倒和危险物预防、药物剂型与提醒支持、向医师报告苯海拉明、营养和失禁支持、喘息服务/成人日间照护资源、社工、照护者支持以及 Diane 自身就医。

stem.en: Which interventions should the nurse include in the Stage 2 home-safety and caregiver-support plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士应将哪些干预纳入第2阶段的居家安全和照护者支持计划？选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA care-plan items, select interventions that are specific, actionable, and tied to a cue. Avoid vague advice or actions that continue the unsafe workaround.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在多选护理计划题中，选择具体、可执行且与线索相对应的干预。避免模糊建议或延续不安全权宜做法的行动。

glossary.defZh: 承认对方的感受真实且可以理解。
用不现实的安慰话语淡化对方担忧。
通过沟通和环境措施降低激动或冲突。

options.en: Immediately list every community resource and safety modification without first responding to Diane's statement that she is failing.
options.zh: 不先回应 Diane 说自己失败了，而是立即列出所有社区资源和安全改造。

options.en: After confirming Margaret is away from the stove, say: 'This is incredibly hard, and I can see how exhausted you are. Asking for help does not mean you are failing her. Let's take this one step at a time together.'
options.zh: 确认 Margaret 已远离炉灶后说：‘这真的非常不容易，我看得出你已经很疲惫。寻求帮助并不表示你辜负了她。我们一起一步一步来。’

options.en: Tell Diane to leave the room so the nurse can correct Margaret's behavior without family interference.
options.zh: 告诉 Diane 离开房间，让护士在没有家属干扰的情况下纠正 Margaret 的行为。

options.en: Say: 'You are doing a great job, and everything will get easier once she settles down.'
options.zh: 说：‘你做得很好，等她安定下来一切都会变容易。’

options.en: Say: 'You cannot raise your voice at a person with dementia; if you keep doing that, I will have to report you.'
options.zh: 说：‘你不能对痴呆患者提高音量；如果你继续这样，我就必须举报你。’

byChoice.en: Resources are needed later, but immediately listing them bypasses Diane's emotional statement.
byChoice.zh: 之后确实需要资源，但立即罗列资源会绕过 Diane 的情绪表达。

byChoice.en: Removing Diane from the interaction frames her as interference rather than a distressed caregiver who needs support and coaching.
byChoice.zh: 让 Diane 离开会把她视为干扰者，而不是需要支持和指导的痛苦照护者。

byChoice.en: This validates the caregiver's distress and reframes help-seeking as appropriate, not failure.
byChoice.zh: 该回应接纳照护者的痛苦，并将寻求帮助重新定义为合适行为，而不是失败。

byChoice.en: This is false reassurance because the situation is not safe or easy, and it dismisses Diane's real distress.
byChoice.zh: 这是虚假安慰，因为情况并不安全也不容易，并且忽视了 Diane 的真实痛苦。

byChoice.en: This is judgmental and threatening; it may shut down disclosure and does not first establish trust.
byChoice.zh: 这带有评判和威胁，可能使对方停止透露信息，也没有先建立信任。

correct.en: The nurse first ensures immediate safety, then validates Diane's exhaustion and guilt without judgment. This builds trust and opens the door to later education and safety planning. Lecturing, threatening, false reassurance, premature resource-listing, or excluding Diane bypasses the emotional cue and can reduce engagement.
correct.zh: 护士首先确保即时安全，然后以非评判方式接纳 Diane 的疲惫和内疚。这能建立信任，为之后教育和安全计划打基础。说教、威胁、虚假安慰、过早罗列资源或排除 Diane 都会绕过情绪线索，并可能降低参与度。

stem.en: During Stage 1, after Margaret is safely away from the stove and Diane says, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her,' which nurse response is most therapeutic?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，当 Margaret 已安全远离炉灶，而 Diane 说‘我撑不下去了，我辜负了她’时，护士哪种回应最具治疗性？

testTakingStrategy.en: In therapeutic communication, answer the feeling before the fact list. Validate distress, avoid false reassurance, and preserve safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 治疗性沟通题中，先回应情绪，再处理事实清单。要接纳痛苦、避免虚假安慰，并维持安全。

glossary.defZh: 判断干预是否产生预期改变。
护理计划是否能在现实中长期维持。
用于判断是否需要升级处理的具体可测量改变。

columns.en: Monitor, but not decisive over this short interval
columns.zh: 需监测，但短期内不具决定性

rows.en: Diane removed the chair from the bedroom door and installed a front-door alarm.
rows.zh: Diane 移除了卧室门上的椅子，并安装了前门警报器。

rows.en: Margaret has received medications daily with a phone alarm, amlodipine liquid, and pharmacist-confirmed crushed lisinopril.
rows.zh: 通过手机提醒、氨氯地平液体剂型和药师确认可压碎的赖诺普利，Margaret 已每日服药。

rows.en: Diphenhydramine was stopped, and Diane reports less morning confusion on nights Margaret slept through.
rows.zh: 苯海拉明已停用；Diane 报告 Margaret 睡整夜后的早晨混乱减少。

rows.en: Diane contacted the Area Agency on Aging, attended an online caregiver support group, and made her own primary-care appointment.
rows.zh: Diane 联系了老龄事务机构，参加了一次线上照护者支持小组，并预约了自己的初级保健。

rows.en: Throw rugs remain in place and cleaning supplies are still unlocked.
rows.zh: 小地毯仍在原处，清洁用品仍未上锁。

rows.en: Margaret is not yet enrolled in the adult day program, and Diane remains the only reliable daily caregiver.
rows.zh: Margaret 尚未报名成人日间照护，Diane 仍是唯一可靠的日常照护者。

rows.en: Margaret's weight is 57.6 kg, down 0.4 kg from five days ago.
rows.zh: Margaret 体重57.6 kg，比5天前下降0.4 kg。

byChoice.en: This is a positive outcome because it replaces a restrictive unsafe workaround with a safer alert strategy.
byChoice.zh: 这是积极结果，因为它用更安全的警报策略替代了限制性的不安全权宜做法。

byChoice.en: A simpler medication system improves reliability compared with the wrong-day organizer pattern.
byChoice.zh: 与日期混乱的药盒相比，更简单的用药系统提高了可靠性。

byChoice.en: Stopping the anticholinergic medication is a positive safety step, with early symptom improvement reported.
byChoice.zh: 停用抗胆碱药物是积极的安全措施，并已有早期症状改善报告。

byChoice.en: These actions show engagement with support resources and attention to caregiver health.
byChoice.zh: 这些行动显示她开始参与支持资源，并关注照护者自身健康。

byChoice.en: Unsecured stove access is a remaining immediate safety hazard.
byChoice.zh: 炉灶未防护仍是即时安全危险。

byChoice.en: Fall and hazardous-material risks remain uncorrected.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒和危险物风险仍未纠正。

byChoice.en: Without respite or formal daytime support, caregiver sustainability remains fragile.
byChoice.zh: 没有喘息服务或正式日间支持，照护可持续性仍然脆弱。

byChoice.en: This is concerning in context but too short a trend to interpret definitively; nutrition and weight need continued monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 结合背景这令人担忧，但5天趋势太短，不能定论；仍需持续监测营养和体重。

byChoice.en: Normal oxygen saturation is not a meaningful short-interval outcome for this caregiver-safety plan.
byChoice.zh: 氧饱和度正常不是评估本照护者安全计划的有意义短期结局。

correct.en: The plan is improving but not adequate yet. Door alarm use, medication reliability, stopping diphenhydramine, and caregiver engagement are positive. The unsecured stove, throw rugs, unlocked cleaning supplies, absent adult-day enrollment, and continued reliance on Diane alone remain safety and sustainability gaps. A 0.4 kg five-day weight drop and normal oxygen saturation should be interpreted cautiously rather than used to declare the plan safe or unsafe by themselves.
correct.zh: 计划正在改善，但尚不足够。门警报、用药更可靠、停用苯海拉明和照护者参与资源是积极信号。炉灶未防护、小地毯、清洁用品未上锁、未报名成人日间照护以及仍主要依赖 Diane 一人，仍是安全和可持续性缺口。5天内体重下降0.4 kg和氧饱和度正常都应谨慎解释，不能单独用来判定计划安全或不安全。

stem.en: At the Stage 3 follow-up, classify each finding as evidence of improvement, a remaining gap requiring follow-up, or a finding that should be monitored but is not decisive over this short interval.
stem.zh: 在第3阶段复诊时，将每项发现分类为改善证据、仍需跟进的缺口，或需要监测但在短期内不能作为决定性依据的发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation often asks for trajectory, not perfection. Credit partial progress while still identifying uncorrected high-risk gaps.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 结局评价常考趋势，而不是完美达标。要承认部分进展，同时识别尚未纠正的高风险缺口。

content.en: While the nurse assesses the home, Margaret stands without warning, walks toward the kitchen, and turns on a stove burner. Diane rushes to turn it off and says Margaret thinks she is making coffee; last week Margaret left a burner on for 20 minutes before Diane noticed. Margaret becomes mildly agitated when redirected, pulls her arm from Diane's grasp, and says loudly, 'Don't touch me! I want my coffee!' Diane raises her voice: 'Mom, stop it! You can't use the stove!' Margaret paces, wrings her hands, and repeats, 'Where is Frank? I want Frank.' Diane sits at the kitchen table, puts her head in her hands, and says quietly, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her.' Diane does not strike, shove, or physically restrain Margaret; her frustration is verbal and self-directed. Margaret's vital signs during agitation are HR 92, BP 156/94, RR 20. She calms after about 10 minutes when the nurse offers decaffeinated tea and speaks slowly and calmly. After calming: HR 78, BP 144/86, RR 16.
content.zh: 护士评估家庭环境时，Margaret 突然站起，走向厨房并打开炉灶。Diane 赶紧关掉炉灶，并说 Margaret 以为自己在煮咖啡；上周 Margaret 曾把炉灶开着20分钟，Diane 才发现。被转移注意时，Margaret 轻度激动，把手从 Diane 手中抽出，大声说：‘别碰我！我要咖啡！’Diane 提高音量：‘妈，停下！你不能用炉灶！’Margaret 来回踱步、绞手，并重复：‘Frank 在哪？我要 Frank。’Diane 坐在厨房桌旁，双手抱头，低声说：‘我撑不下去了。我辜负了她。’Diane 没有打、推或身体限制 Margaret；她的挫败表现为言语和自责。Margaret 激动时生命体征为HR 92、BP 156/94、RR 20。护士提供无咖啡因茶，并用缓慢平静语气陪伴后，约10分钟后 Margaret 平静。平静后：HR 78、BP 144/86、RR 16。

title.zh: 激动 episode 与照护者反应

content.en: With Margaret calm and seated, the nurse speaks privately with Diane. Diane reports crushing Margaret's amlodipine and lisinopril tablets into applesauce because Margaret spits out pills; Diane is unsure whether Margaret swallows all the applesauce. She estimates Margaret receives most medications most days but missed them entirely 2 days last week because Diane overslept. Margaret fell in the bathroom 3 days ago, with no visible injury; Diane helped her up but did not report the fall because she feared being judged. Diane's brother recently told her she 'just needs to try harder.' The nurse confirms today's Tuesday medication compartment is still full and Wednesday's compartment is empty. Diane says she must have mixed up the days and cannot keep track anymore. Diane has also been giving diphenhydramine 25 mg at bedtime for 3 weeks to help Margaret sleep; it worked at first but now Margaret seems more confused in the morning.
content.zh: Margaret 平静坐下后，护士与 Diane 私下交谈。Diane 报告因 Margaret 会吐出药片，她把 Margaret 的氨氯地平和赖诺普利压碎混入苹果泥；但她不确定 Margaret 是否吃完所有苹果泥。她估计 Margaret 大多数天能吃到大多数药，但上周有2天因为 Diane 睡过头而完全漏服。3天前 Margaret 在浴室跌倒，没有可见外伤；Diane 扶她起来但没有报告，因为害怕被评判。Diane 的哥哥最近说她‘只需要再努力一点’。护士确认今天星期二的药格仍满，星期三药格为空。Diane 说自己一定把日期弄混了，已经无法跟上。Diane 还连续3周在睡前给 Margaret 苯海拉明25 mg帮助睡眠；最初有效，但现在 Margaret 早晨似乎更混乱。

title.en: Stage 2 — Later the same visit, 11:30 AM-noon

content.en:
Since the first visit, the nurse coordinated a social-work referral, gave Diane Area Agency on Aging and caregiver support group contact information, and contacted the primary care provider about diphenhydramine use, the unreported fall, medication difficulties, weight loss, and BP readings. The provider discontinued diphenhydramine, ordered a pharmacy consultation for alternative formulations, referred Margaret to physical therapy for fall-risk assessment, and referred her to a dietitian.

Diane called the Area Agency on Aging and learned about an adult day program 3 miles away that operates Monday-Friday, 8 AM-4 PM. She is thinking about enrollment. She attended one online caregiver support group and felt less alone. She removed the chair from the bedroom door and installed a front-door alarm that chimes when the door opens. She has not addressed the stove, throw rugs, or unlocked cleaning supplies. Margaret's medications have been given daily with a phone alarm. The pharmacy delivered amlodipine oral liquid, which Margaret accepts in juice. Lisinopril is still crushed in applesauce after pharmacist confirmation that the tablet is crushable.

Margaret appears slightly more alert. Diane reports Margaret slept through the night twice in 5 days since diphenhydramine stopped, with less morning confusion on those days. Urinary incontinence continues 2-3 times daily. Meal intake over the past 2 days is about 50%, improved from the prior 25%-30% estimate. Weight is 57.6 kg, down 0.4 kg from 5 days ago; this trend is too short to interpret definitively. Vitals: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 138/82, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Perineal erythema is unchanged. No new falls. Margaret tried to open the front door once at night; the alarm woke Diane, who redirected her without incident. Diane reports some sleep improvement, fewer headaches, and a primary-care appointment next week, but still has no formal respite in place.
content.zh:
自第一次访视后，护士协调社工转介，提供老龄事务机构和照护者支持小组联系方式，并就苯海拉明使用、未报告跌倒、用药困难、体重下降和血压读数联系初级保健医生。医生停用了苯海拉明，开出药师会诊以寻找替代剂型，转介物理治疗评估跌倒风险，并转介营养师。

Diane 联系了老龄事务机构，得知距家3英里的成人日间照护项目，周一至周五8:00–16:00开放。她正在考虑报名。她参加了一次线上照护者支持小组，感觉不那么孤单。她移除了卧室门口的椅子，并安装了前门警报器，门打开时会响。她尚未处理炉灶、小地毯或未上锁清洁用品。Margaret 通过手机提醒已每日服药。药房送来了氨氯地平口服液，Margaret 可用果汁服用。经药师确认赖诺普利片可压碎后，仍压碎混入苹果泥。

Margaret 看起来稍微更清醒。Diane 报告自停用苯海拉明后的5天中，Margaret 有2晚睡整夜，且这些天早晨混乱减少。尿失禁仍每天2–3次。过去2天进食约50%，比之前估计的25%–30%有所改善。体重57.6 kg，比5天前下降0.4 kg；该趋势太短，不能定论。生命体征：T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，HR 74，BP 138/82，RR 16，SpO₂ 98%。会阴发红未变。无新跌倒。Margaret 夜间曾试图打开前门一次；警报叫醒 Diane，Diane 将她重新引导回床，无意外。Diane 报告睡眠有所改善、头痛减少，并已预约下周初级保健，但尚未落实正式喘息服务。

title.en: Stage 3 — Follow-up home visit, five days later

summary.en: Margaret Tierney is a 78-year-old woman with moderate Alzheimer's dementia who lives with her daughter Diane, her sole caregiver. Diane requested home-health support after two months of worsening nighttime wandering and confusion, stating she cannot continue alone. The case unfolds across an initial home visit, later same-visit disclosures, and a five-day follow-up.
summary.zh: Margaret Tierney，78岁，中度阿尔茨海默病，与女儿 Diane 同住；Diane 是唯一照护者。因过去两个月夜间走失和意识混乱加重，Diane 请求居家护理支持，并表示自己无法再独自承担。病例按初次居家访视、同次访视后续透露信息和5天后复诊逐步展开。

title.en: Caregiver role strain in home management of moderate Alzheimer's dementia
title.zh: 中度阿尔茨海默病居家照护中的照护者角色压力

glossary.defZh: 一种进行性神经认知障碍，会损害记忆、判断、沟通和功能。
照护需求超过资源时导致的痛苦和功能受损。
痴呆患者无目的或不安全走动，可导致走失或受伤。
为照护者提供暂时休息，以帮助维持居家照护。

correct.en: This case centers on caregiver role strain affecting home safety for a client with moderate dementia. Margaret has cognitive impairment, wandering, unsafe stove use, nutrition and hydration concerns, incontinence-related skin risk, fall risk, and unreliable medication administration. Diane shows sleep deprivation, weight loss, work impairment, tremor, guilt, and unsafe coping strategies. The nurse's role is to preserve trust, mitigate immediate hazards, coordinate provider/pharmacy/social-work/community resources, avoid premature accusation of intentional abuse while still documenting and following reporting policy, and evaluate whether safety and caregiver capacity are improving over time.
correct.zh: 本病例核心是照护者角色压力影响中度痴呆患者的居家安全。Margaret 有认知受损、走失、炉灶不安全使用、营养和液体摄入担忧、失禁相关皮肤风险、跌倒风险和用药不可靠。Diane 表现出睡眠剥夺、体重下降、工作受影响、手颤、内疚和不安全应对策略。护士的作用是维护信任、减轻即时危险、协调医师/药师/社工/社区资源，避免过早指控故意虐待，同时仍需记录并按政策处理报告问题，并持续评价安全与照护者能力是否改善。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track the unfolding data by stage. Early questions focus on cue recognition and therapeutic response; later questions add medication, fall, and safety disclosures; follow-up questions test whether partial improvement is enough.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 按阶段追踪逐步出现的信息。早期题关注线索识别和治疗性回应；后续题加入用药、跌倒和安全补充信息；复诊题考查部分改善是否足够。

tokens.en: Immediately list community resources during Diane's 'I'm failing her' statement without first validating her distress.
tokens.zh: 在 Diane 说‘我辜负了她’时，不先接纳她的痛苦，而是立即列出社区资源。

tokens.en: Mitigate immediate hazards by replacing the bedroom-door barricade with a nonrestrictive door alarm and preventing unsupervised stove access today.
tokens.zh: 今天通过用非限制性门警报替代卧室挡门，并防止无人看护时接触炉灶，减轻即时危险。

tokens.en: Contact the primary care provider about diphenhydramine use and advocate for discontinuation and safer sleep evaluation.
tokens.zh: 就苯海拉明使用联系初级保健医生，并倡导停用及进行更安全的睡眠问题评估。

tokens.en: Accuse Diane of intentional abuse based only on the chair barricade and raised voice.
tokens.zh: 仅根据椅子挡门和提高音量就指责 Diane 故意虐待。

tokens.en: Caregiver burnout requiring immediate removal from the home
tokens.zh: 需要立即离家安置的照护者耗竭

tokens.en: Intentional elder abuse or willful neglect as the primary explanation
tokens.zh: 以故意虐待老人或蓄意忽视作为主要解释

tokens.en: Completion of home safety modifications: door alarm in place, stove secured, throw rugs removed, and cleaning supplies locked.
tokens.zh: 居家安全改造完成情况：门警报已安装、炉灶已防护、小地毯已移除、清洁用品已上锁。

tokens.en: Diane's sleep, appetite, support-resource engagement, adult-day enrollment progress, and her own primary-care follow-up.
tokens.zh: Diane 的睡眠、食欲、支持资源参与、成人日间照护报名进展以及她自己的初级保健跟进。
单独监测 Margaret 的氧饱和度。

tokens.en: A short-interval formal cognitive screening score as the main outcome.
tokens.zh: 将短期正式认知筛查分数作为主要结局。

glossary.defZh: 一种NGN题型，将状况、行动和监测参数连接起来。
最直接降低即时或核心风险的干预。
用于评价计划是否有效或是否需要升级处理的指标。

byChoice.en: This is supported by the caregiver's exhaustion, guilt, functional impairment, unsafe coping, and voluntary request for help.
byChoice.zh: 照护者疲惫、内疚、功能受损、不安全应对以及主动求助支持这一判断。

byChoice.en: Intentional abuse is less likely as the primary explanation because there are no injury patterns, Diane's frustration is self-directed, and she is seeking help; safety and reporting assessment still matter.
byChoice.zh: 故意虐待作为主要解释较不可能，因为没有损伤模式，Diane 的挫败主要指向自责，并且她正在寻求帮助；但安全和报告评估仍然重要。

byChoice.en: Immediate removal is not the first conclusion because Diane denies intent to harm, remains engaged, and several hazards are modifiable with urgent support.
byChoice.zh: 立即离家安置不是第一结论，因为 Diane 否认伤害意图，仍愿意参与，且多项危险可通过紧急支持改变。

byChoice.en: Elopement and stove access are immediate life-safety threats that must be reduced before Diane leaves or supervision changes.
byChoice.zh: 走失和炉灶接触是即时生命安全威胁，必须在 Diane 离开或看护变化前降低。

byChoice.en: Diphenhydramine is contributing to confusion and fall/wandering risk and requires provider-directed discontinuation and evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 苯海拉明会加重混乱并增加跌倒/走失风险，需要医师指导停用和评估。

byChoice.en: Accusation based on only two cues ignores the broader pattern and can destroy the therapeutic relationship, though documentation and policy-guided reporting assessment remain necessary.
byChoice.zh: 仅凭两个线索指责会忽略整体模式，并可能破坏治疗性关系；但仍需记录并按政策评估报告。

byChoice.en: Resources are important, but giving a list before validating Diane's distress bypasses the emotional cue and may reduce engagement.
byChoice.zh: 资源很重要，但在接纳 Diane 的痛苦前就列清单会绕过情绪线索，并可能降低参与度。

byChoice.en: Concrete safety modifications are observable outcomes that show whether immediate environmental risks are being reduced.
byChoice.zh: 具体安全改造是可观察结局，可显示即时环境风险是否正在降低。

byChoice.en: The caregiver's sleep, appetite, support engagement, respite, and health follow-up determine whether home care is sustainable.
byChoice.zh: 照护者的睡眠、食欲、支持参与、喘息服务和健康跟进决定居家照护是否可持续。

byChoice.en: Oxygen saturation is normal and not related to the primary caregiver-safety problem.
byChoice.zh: 氧饱和度正常，且与主要照护者安全问题无关。

byChoice.en: Formal cognitive scores can help staging, but they are not the key short-interval outcome for this safety and caregiver-support plan.
byChoice.zh: 正式认知评分可帮助分期，但不是本安全与照护者支持计划的关键短期结局。

correct.en: The most likely condition is caregiver role strain. Diane's exhaustion, weight loss, missed work, guilt, unsafe but problem-directed strategies, and willingness to accept help fit role strain more than intentional abuse or immediate removal. The priority actions are to control same-day elopement and stove hazards and to contact the provider about diphenhydramine because it worsens confusion and risk. Monitoring should focus on completion of concrete safety modifications and Diane's ability to recover sleep, nutrition, support, respite, and health care follow-up.
correct.zh: 最可能状况是照护者角色压力。Diane 的疲惫、体重下降、误工、内疚、不安全但针对问题的策略，以及愿意接受帮助，更符合角色压力，而不是故意虐待或需要立即离家安置。优先行动是控制当天的走失和炉灶危险，并就苯海拉明联系医师，因为它会加重混乱和风险。监测应聚焦于具体安全改造是否完成，以及 Diane 的睡眠、营养、支持、喘息服务和自身医疗跟进是否改善。

stem.en: At the end of the initial home-health visit, Margaret has moderate dementia with worsening wandering, stove-use risk, weight loss, incontinence-related skin irritation, a recent unreported fall, medication-administration problems, and bedtime diphenhydramine use. Diane is the sole caregiver and reports severe sleep deprivation, weight loss, missed work, guilt, and fear of being judged. She raised her voice during an agitation episode but did not strike, shove, threaten, or physically restrain Margaret, and she voluntarily requested home-health help. Complete the bow-tie by selecting the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
stem.zh: 初次居家护理访视结束时，Margaret 有中度痴呆，并出现走失加重、炉灶使用风险、体重下降、失禁相关皮肤刺激、近期未报告跌倒、给药困难以及睡前使用苯海拉明。Diane 是唯一照护者，报告严重睡眠剥夺、体重下降、误工、内疚和害怕被评判。她在激动 episode 中提高了音量，但没有打、推、威胁或身体限制 Margaret，并且主动请求居家护理帮助。请完成弓形题：选择最可能状况、两个优先行动和两个需要监测的参数。

testTakingStrategy.en: For bow-tie items, identify the central problem first, then choose actions and monitoring parameters that directly match it. Avoid distractors that are punitive, premature, or unrelated to the priority risk.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做弓形题时，先识别中心问题，再选择与之直接匹配的行动和监测参数。避免惩罚性、过早或与优先风险无关的干扰项。
